reason: The reported negative effect (-1.96) depends entirely on controlling for buyer_rating_2023, a same-year (2023) post-treatment variable that is itself strongly driven by supplier_diversity (b=0.66, p<1e-100), so it is a collider/mediator. Without it, using only pre-period controls, the estimate is positive (about +0.60, p=0.008), and with no controls it is +2.23, so the report's 'negative effect' conclusion is not supported.
